title: UI wave 2 U4: Popover primitive; Dropdown, Sort and toolbar panels on it (B)
description: Plan task U4. Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-26-ui-wave-2/PLAN.md exactly: this task's section (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) plus the seven answered Open questions and the Notes for the implementer. review.note:
APPROVE. Reviewer agent-f5e6 (Claude Opus). Status stays CLAIMED (Chromium only; no owner use, no native menu proof).

INTERFACES (read): PopoverProps, Popover, PopoverItem, DropdownOption.shortcut, SHORTCUTS (14 keys, exact strings), visibleLabel match PLAN U4 exactly. popover.css matches step 1 (+ white-space:nowrap on hints). Dropdown keyboard code byte-identical: diff of ui2-u4/Dropdown.pre.tsx:102-180 vs src/components/Dropdown.tsx:66-144 -> IDENTICAL; only the placement + outside-click effects were removed (now in Popover), focus-on-open kept. tests/accessibility.spec.ts: no git diff. React ^19 (ref as prop OK). T099 carry-forward fix present (src/motion.ts:260-261 clientLeft/clientTop).

MY RUNS (pinned Node 22.23.3, fresh build ui2-u4-review/dist, port 1596, workers 1, retries 0; tree also contains live T104/T119/T121 hunks): vitest designTokens+motion 27/27; tsc --noEmit exit 0; Playwright accessibility 4/4, motion 7/7, assets 9/9 (alt-text flow), editor-toolbar 4/4, projects-screen 34/34, research 10/10 = 68/68 (pw-tests.log).
REVIEW PROBE (ui2-u4-review/probe, 4/4 pass; probe-summary.json): at 850x600 every opened popover inside the viewport and clipped by NO ancestor overflow: Sort, zoom/paragraph/font, More, More>spacing, More>prose check, More>page setup, page setup>Paper size and Page margins (dropdown nested in panel nested in More), sidebar draft status (cards view), Settings Goal scope/Goal day/Export typeface/Line spacing (23 popovers). Every popover: 1px solid border, radius 0, shadow, exactly one .popover-highlight. Open = clip-path inset(0 0 100%)+opacity 0->1, 180 ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); close = 120 ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1). Closing frame: data-state=closing, role null, aria-label null, inert, aria-hidden=true, listbox role query 0; node removed afterwards. Item opacity sampled every rAF during opening: 55 frames, all 1; item animations transform only. Highlight move: same element, one transform-only animation. Highlight vs item in a bordered SCROLLED font menu (scrollTop 130): 0.0 px delta; after re-scrolling to 0 still 0.0 px.
STRICTMODE (vite dev on 1597, main.tsx StrictMode): motion (d)(e)(f)(g) pass and probe closing/opaque/highlight test passes. First dev attempt failed (d) with 'execution context destroyed by navigation' = Vite cold-start dep-optimisation reload; rerun (d)(e) 2/2 pass (pw-dev.log, pw-dev2.log).
LOAD FAILURES: notice:69 and performance:100 are not U4: same pre-U4 ui2-u10 dist passed 8/8 at 04:13Z (ui2-u4/cmp-u10.log) and failed notice 3/4 + perf 1/2 at 04:33Z under load (ui2-u4/cmp-u10/report.json). pw-full.log's 11 failures = 4 markdown-roundtrip (config lacked PW_DIST_DIR, fixed) + footnotes:65 (T121 focus race, now fixed in T121's test) + notice x4 + perf x2; nothing else.
ALT-TEXT DEVIATION: sound and necessary -- the dialog used .toolbar-popover, whose background/border/shadow U4 moved onto .popover, so leaving it a plain div would have rendered it transparent. Behaviour kept (focus effect, Enter/Escape, Cancel/Insert); assets 9/9 pass. Cosmetic: during the 120 ms close the file name is blank (pendingFile?.name is null).
SCREENSHOTS viewed: worker's sort-zoom light/dark, paragraph-dark, panel-dark, more-light, nested-font-850; mine (ui2-u4-review/shots) sort light/dark, paragraph light/dark, more light/dark, more-panel dark. Raised surface, 1px line, soft shadow, square corners, grey highlight under the item, hints right-aligned muted on one line (⌥⌘0/1/2). Native PNGs (ui2-u4/native, 10) viewed: unchanged screens; native-screens opens NO menu, so nothing about WKWebView menus is proven. pdf-preview light+dark both lack the 'Reveal sidebar on hover' checkbox at that scroll position -- same in both modes, not a popover, not U4 (sidebar row U8/U9 moves anyway).

CARRY-FORWARD (T099 list): CLOSED -- DoD 2 reversal without remount (motion (e), prod + dev); usePresence + slideHighlight exercised in real UI in Chromium prod and StrictMode dev; highlight alignment in a bordered, scrolled popover (motion (g) + my font-menu probe, 0 px). STILL OPEN -- native WebKit menu behaviour and Mac Reduce Motion (no native run opens a menu); slideHighlight(null) mid-slide snap (motion.ts untouched, minor); held finished hide animation on the unmounted node (harmless).

NOTES, not blockers: (1) More uses highlight="follow" but its buttons carry no data-popover-item yet, so More has no highlight/stagger until U6 step 3 adds it -- U6 reviewer check. (2) Popover.tsx:94 skips the max-height cap for overflow:visible toolbar panels (needed so nested menus spill out); all panels fit 850x600 today. (3) .dropdown-menu (dropdown.css:43-63) still duplicates .popover's position/surface/overflow -- redundant, not wrong. (4) DESIGN DOC text is in the done note for U20.

Focus traces in ui2-u4/dbg/. Reported on board (#379); test should not depend on that ordering. Not edited (not T101's file).

NATIVE: smoke rebuild ok (smoke-build.log); native-screens 10 PNGs viewed: projects/writing/research/settings/pdf-preview light+dark render as before, Sort trigger and toolbar dropdown triggers unchanged, pdfProbe application/pdf both modes. pdf-preview light/dark show the 'Reveal sidebar on hover' label without its checkbox at the scroll position captured (looks like a capture/scroll artifact, not a popover; flag for reviewer). This proves nothing about menus opening in WKWebView (the script opens none), nor Mac Reduce Motion.
CARRY-FORWARD: DoD 2 reversal proven by motion (e) (same node, role restored, no data-state after reopen mid-close). usePresence + slideHighlight exercised in real UI by (d)-(g) in the production build. Highlight alignment in a bordered, scrolled popover: (g) asserts highlight rect == item rect within 0.5px with scrollTop>0 and 1px border -- passes. NOT done: React StrictMode dev-mount run (prod preview only; dev build check skipped to free the slot) and native WebKit menu behaviour -- remain for the reviewer. slideHighlight(null) mid-slide snap: not changed (motion.ts read-only). Stagger: highlight measured mid-stagger is re-measured when the stagger finishes.
DESIGN DOC: (for U20, add a 'Popover' section after Motion) Every menu and toolbar panel renders through src/components/Popover.tsx (popover.css): Dropdown (and so Sort), the toolbar panels (spacing, setup, aids, table, image alt text) and the More menu. Surface --elevation-raised, 1 px --line border, --shadow-raised, square corners. It sits below its anchor, flips up when it fits better above, flips to the anchor's right edge when it would leave the viewport, and caps its height (toolbar panels keep overflow: visible so nested menus can spill out). Opening grows it from the anchor edge by clip-path with a fade of the surface (--duration-base, --ease-out); closing runs --duration-fast --ease-in; a reopen mid-close reverses from the current frame without remounting. While closing it carries data-state="closing", inert and aria-hidden and drops its role and label, so role queries see it gone at once. Items ([data-popover-item]) are opaque from the first frame; a fresh opening staggers them by transform only (15 ms per item). One .popover-highlight box slides behind the highlighted item (Dropdown) or follows hover and focus (highlight="follow", the More menu). PopoverItem presses to scale(0.99) over --duration-press. Shortcut hints (.popover-shortcut, from src/editor/shortcuts.ts) sit right-aligned in --muted at --type-small on one line, only where the editor really installs the shortcut. Dropdown menus size to their content (max 320 px).
